_note: Bibliography for the Cell Digital Twin. Each entry is referenced by key from data/*.params.json and from transporter/flux definitions. DOIs are included only where known with confidence; where omitted, the full citation text is given so the source can be located. 'search' provides a fallback lookup URL.

lew_bookchin_1986.title: Volume, pH, and ion-content regulation in human red cells: analysis of transient behavior with an integrated model
lew_bookchin_1986.note: The integrated Lew-Bookchin red-cell homeostasis model: pump-leak balance, Donnan equilibrium, osmotic volume regulation.

lew_bookchin_2005.title: Ion transport pathology in the mechanism of sickle cell dehydration
lew_bookchin_2005.note: Review of red-cell ion transport, the Gardos channel, and the Reference (RCM) red-cell model.

tiffert_lew_2001.title: Kinetics of calcium pumping in intact human red blood cells
tiffert_lew_2001.search: Tiffert Lew calcium pump human red blood cells Journal of Physiology
tiffert_lew_2001.note: Plasma-membrane Ca2+-ATPase (PMCA) kinetics and the very low resting free [Ca2+]i in erythrocytes (~20-60 nM).

mulquiney_kuchel_1999.title: Model of 2,3-bisphosphoglycerate metabolism in the human erythrocyte based on detailed enzyme kinetic equations: equations and parameter refinement
mulquiney_kuchel_1999.note: Detailed kinetic model of human erythrocyte glycolysis and the 2,3-BPG (Rapoport-Luebering) shunt.

joshi_palsson_1989.title: Metabolic dynamics in the human red cell. Part I-A comprehensive kinetic model
joshi_palsson_1989.note: Whole-cell kinetic model of erythrocyte energy metabolism (glycolysis, ATP turnover).

lowe_walmsley_1986.title: The kinetics of glucose transport in human red blood cells
lowe_walmsley_1986.note: GLUT1 facilitated-diffusion kinetics in human erythrocytes; zero-trans Km ~1-2 mM.

gardos_1958.title: The function of calcium in the potassium permeability of human erythrocytes
gardos_1958.note: Original description of the Ca2+-activated K+ (Gardos) channel, KCNN4/KCa3.1.

hoffman_2003.authors: Hoffman JF, Joiner W, Nehrke K, Potapova O, Foye K, Wickrema A
hoffman_2003.title: The hSK4 (KCNN4) isoform is the Ca2+-activated K+ channel (Gardos channel) in human red blood cells
hoffman_2003.journal: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences USA
hoffman_2003.note: Molecular identity and Ca2+ sensitivity (K0.5 ~ sub-micromolar) of the Gardos channel.

jennings_1989.title: Structure and function of the red blood cell anion transport protein (Band 3 / AE1)
jennings_1989.journal: Annual Review of Biophysics and Biophysical Chemistry
jennings_1989.note: Band 3 (AE1, SLC4A1) electroneutral Cl-/HCO3- exchange; very high turnover sustaining the chloride shift.

garrahan_glynn_1967.title: The stoichiometry of the sodium pump
garrahan_glynn_1967.note: Na+/K+-ATPase stoichiometry: 3 Na+ extruded / 2 K+ imported per ATP hydrolyzed.

post_1972.authors: Post RL, Hegyvary C, Kume S
post_1972.title: Activation by adenosine triphosphate in the phosphorylation kinetics of sodium and potassium ion transport adenosine triphosphatase
post_1972.note: Na+/K+-ATPase kinetics; basis for Hill dependence on internal Na+ and external K+.

luo_rudy_1991.title: A model of the ventricular cardiac action potential. Depolarization, repolarization, and their interaction
luo_rudy_1991.note: The Luo-Rudy phase I (LR91) guinea-pig ventricular action-potential model.

ten_tusscher_2006.title: Alternans and spiral breakup in a human ventricular tissue model
ten_tusscher_2006.journal: American Journal of Physiology - Heart and Circulatory Physiology
ten_tusscher_2006.note: Human ventricular myocyte model (TT06); planned extension target for the cardiomyocyte.

hodgkin_huxley_1952.title: A quantitative description of membrane current and its application to conduction and excitation in nerve
hodgkin_huxley_1952.note: Voltage-gated channel gating kinetics (the x-infinity / tau formalism used throughout).

goldman_1943.title: Potential, impedance, and rectification in membranes

rush_larsen_1978.title: A practical algorithm for solving dynamic membrane equations
rush_larsen_1978.note: Exponential integrator for Hodgkin-Huxley gating variables; unconditionally stable for gating.

alberts_mboc.authors: Alberts B, Heald R, Johnson A, Morgan D, Raff M, Roberts K, Walter P
alberts_mboc.title: Molecular Biology of the Cell, 7th edition
alberts_mboc.note: Standard textbook reference for membrane transport mechanisms and physiological concentration ranges.

lodish_molcell.authors: Lodish H, Berk A, Kaiser CA, et al.
lodish_molcell.title: Molecular Cell Biology, 9th edition
lodish_molcell.note: Textbook reference for transporter classes (uniport, symport, antiport, pumps) and ion gradients.
